facts.fact: The Ministry of Information and Communication Technology issued the National Broadband Policy 2012-2020 (NBP2012) in January 2012, with a period that ran to 2020, and the document names no successor policy.

systems.owner: Ministry of Information and Communication Technology

note: No delivery fact: the passages give no funding tied to the policy and no figures set against its targets, only commitments to publish a timetable, evaluation and dashboard.
